purpose: taxids for 25 clade/species names, by exact ontology label, batch 3
sparql: PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> PREFIX obo: <http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/> SELECT ?t ?l WHERE { ?t rdfs:label ?l . FILTER(REGEX(STR(?t),'NCBITaxon_[0-9]+$')) FILTER(REGEX(?l, "^(Murinae|Mus|Primates|Carnivora|Artiodactyla|Ecdysozoa|Arthropoda|Hexapoda|Insecta|Diptera|Drosophila|Nematoda|Lophotrochozoa|Mollusca|Gastropoda|Annelida|Platyhelminthes|Cnidaria|Hydrozoa|Porifera|Echinodermata|Danio rerio|Oryzias latipes|Xenopus laevis|Drosophila melanogaster)( <[^>]*>)?$")) }
